canonical_form: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of this entire object except content_digest; keys sorted recursively, separators comma and colon, ensure_ascii=false, no whitespace or trailing newline; array order retained.
bank_scoped_bindings: No target routing scope after DT-M1 K6. Preserve the raw binding as unresolved with its original bank, command and arguments; install no active binding. Only an explicit checked rebind can enable it.
unresolved_arguments: Stored object references resolve from captured legacy data or an explicit checked rebind; absent data stays unresolved. Invocation guards (action hint, preview, checked file and token) are acquired afresh at invocation and are never imported permission.
twist_bindings: Resolve the exact word the 0.4 key typed under its saved cap and frame. Do not translate T3 labels by spelling; DT-M1 K2 swaps their names. Key-map replay tests need EN3 and the engine.
